# Test Fixtures

- `testfile.rar5.rar` and `testfile.rar5-images.rar` are from `ssokolow/rar-test-files`, a public RAR test fixture repository released under CC0 for redistributable archive integration tests.
- `testfile.rar5-images.rar` is the repository's `.cbr` fixture saved with a `.rar` extension so the application exercises the same RAR decoder through the user-supported `.rar` input path.
- Source: https://github.com/ssokolow/rar-test-files
